text: Completed typed rigid and temporal foundation: Rigid3/Twist6 validate SE(3), preserve frame polarity, rebind checked cross-registry values onto declared live owners, and expose singleton-preserving constructors. RigidPose/PoseSeries restore only proper transforms; TimedScalarSamples.volumeAt is a zero-copy D3-plus-Time view; PoseTrajectory covers nonuniform knots and explicit extrapolation; acquisition schedules validate volume/slice/packet semantics; pose-derived metrics use relative SE(3) logs. Focused sbt reframe4s-lieJVM/test reframe4s-lieJS/test reframe4s-motionJVM/test reframe4s-motionJS/test passed: 12 Lie and 12 motion tests on each platform, warning-clean.
